quotations.old_english: Hwerhwettan gesihþ on swefnum untrumnysse getácnaþ
quotations.english: if a man sees in dreams a cucumber it betokens illness

source_text: hwer-hwette, an; f. A cucumber :-- Hwerhwette cucumer, Ælfc. Gl. 40; Som. 63, 99; Wrt. Voc. 30, 47. Hwerwette, L. M. 1, 23; Lchdm. ii. 66, 9. Hwerhwettan gesihþ on swefnum untrumnysse getácnaþ if a man sees in dreams a cucumber it betokens illness, Lchdm. iii. 200, 16.
